rbins:ishango-bone-1950.name: Jean de Heinzelin
rbins:ishango-bone-1950.role: Geologist and leader of the 1950 excavation
rbins:ishango-bone-1950.detail: The excavation on the Congolese shore of Lake Edward recovered this bone. Its maker’s name and the purpose of the groups remain open.

columbia:plimpton-cuneiform-322.name: George Arthur Plimpton
columbia:plimpton-cuneiform-322.detail: The gift came to Columbia University Libraries in 1936. The tablet belongs to Old Babylonian Larsa.

columbia:plimpton-cuneiform-322.name: Eleanor Robson
columbia:plimpton-cuneiform-322.detail: She interprets the entries in the context of a teacher preparing right-triangle and reciprocal-pair problems.

bodleian:ms-sansk-d-14.name: Takao Hayashi
bodleian:ms-sansk-d-14.detail: His study used the writing and mathematical content to propose an age. This method gives readers a separate line of evidence from the later bark samples.
